description:
About the company
 
 Our client is an industrial technology startup developing software and advanced manufacturing systems. Its engineers connect digital products with real-world production processes.
 
 The role
 
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join as a Founding Software Engineer and own software across factory operations, automation, and simulation. You will act as a product engineer, identifying problems and delivering solutions independently.
 
 What you'll do
 
 - Build systems for supply chain, quoting, pricing, inventory, and production flow.
 
 - Develop simulation tools using manufacturing data.
 
 - Ingest equipment telemetry and orchestrate automation.
 
 - Build data models that represent physical manufacturing processes.
 
 - Work with hardware and automation engineers on end-to-end solutions.
 
 - Identify product priorities, set goals, and ship production software.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 - 2+ years of experience shipping production-grade software.
 
 - Full-stack TypeScript experience with Python or Go backend skills.
 
 - Ability to own products and technical decisions end to end.
 
 - Experience designing backend systems that model real-world processes.
 
 - Comfort working independently through ambiguity and defining user needs.
 
 - Ability to meet the client's applicable export-control eligibility requirements.
 
 Bonus points
 
 - Manufacturing software, automation, or factory exposure.
 
 - CAD, computational geometry, or 3D systems experience.
 
 - Data engineering or simulation experience.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 - Base salary: USD 140,000 to 200,000 per year.
 
 - Equity: 0.2% to 1.0%.
 
 - Relocation support.
 
 - Meals and productivity tools are covered.
 
 - A signing bonus may be considered.
 
 Location and work model
 
 - Los Angeles, California, United States.
 
 - Five days per week onsite.
